title: Rigidity of self-maps of $V_{n,2}$ and manifolds tangentially homotopy equivalent to $V_{n,2} \times S^k$
summary: We study two problems concerning the Stiefel manifolds $V_{n,2}$ and their products with spheres. First, we address a rigidity problem: we determine, for most values of~$n$, all self-maps of $V_{n,2}$ that are homotopic to an almost diffeomorphism. Second, we classify smooth closed manifolds tangentially homotopy equivalent to $V_{n,2} \times S^k$ up to almost diffeomorphism, for $k = 3, 5$ or $7 \leq k, k \neq 2^i - 2 \ \text{and} \ Dim(V_{n,2} \times S^k) \neq 2^i - 2$.
